units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:8">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:2:5">Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ</cite> top <he>א׳ מלבינקי</he> a band (of bast) with which mala punica (pomegranates) are tied together.—Pl. <he>אֱגוֹדִים</he>, const. <he>אֱגוֹדֵי</he>.

Peah VI, 10 א׳ השום stalks of garlic plant used for tying bunches; [oth. opin. bunches of garlic on one stalk], opp. to אגודות tied bunches. [Tosef. ib. III, 8 אוגוּרֵי ed. Zuck., piles of garlic, v. אֵגוֹר.] [Num. R. s. 4 beg. חטים אגודיהם, v. אֵגוֹרִי.]
